sources.title: Slagmolen — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: Two-Michelin-starred restaurant; villa rooms built to prolong the evening in style.

sources.title: Slagmolen — overnight booking
sources.claim: Four on-site villa rooms; phone-only booking +32 89 85 48 88; breakfast and minibar included.

sources.title: De Slagmolen
sources.claim: Restaurant and villa rooms at the watermill.

sources.title: Hotels near Slagmolen — Tripadvisor
sources.claim: Only Bed and Beyond (1.6 km) sits inside 2 km; next-nearest is 3.7 km.

sources.title: Bed and Beyond
sources.claim: Designer-host B&B on Vinkenkantstraat 33, Opglabbeek; indoor plunge pool, sauna, sanarium.

sources.title: Uber — Opglabbeek coverage
sources.claim: Uber operates in Opglabbeek but driver availability is thin after dark.

sources.title: Hostellerie Vivendum — Michelin Guide
sources.claim: One Michelin star in Dilsen-Stokkem; terrace flagged as one of Belgium's finest.

sources.title: Hostellerie Vivendum — hotel
sources.claim: 1736 chaplain's residence with 5 rooms (incl. suite + duplex loft); rooms sold only paired with dinner.

sources.title: Restaurant Vivendum
sources.claim: Hotel-restaurant in Dilsen-Stokkem.

sources.title: Hotel Mardaga
sources.claim: 4-star, 18 renovated rooms in As; gastronomic restaurant, Tesla charger.

sources.title: Carbon Hotel
sources.claim: Coal-black design hotel in Genk; Carbon Sense City Spa on the fifth floor.

sources.title: Warredal
sources.claim: Cabins, treehouses and a Hobbit House in woodland on the edge of Hoge Kempen.

sources.title: Hotel de Maretak
sources.claim: Small 6-room inn near the Oude Maas; private wellness, guests-only restaurant.

sources.title: Kasteel Wurfeld
sources.claim: 32-room castle hotel on 2.5 ha grounds in Maaseik.

sources.title: Hotel Stiemerheide
sources.claim: English-cottage golf hotel; Restaurant Moonstone carries a Bib Gourmand.

sources.title: Landhuisjes Bij De Wouterbron
sources.claim: Self-catering bungalows in a nature reserve in Opglabbeek; seasonal swim pond.

sources.title: Hoge Kempen National Park — Gateways
sources.claim: Nine official gateways into Belgium's only national park; seven inside the 30 km arc.

sources.title: Mechelse Heide gateway
sources.claim: Purple heath; 7 loops, 1.5 km wheelchair-accessible Zandloperpad; 104 m panorama point.

sources.title: Station As gateway
sources.claim: 31 m André Dumont derrick replica tower; visitor centre Tue-Sun 09:30-17:00 (Apr-Nov).

sources.title: Pietersheim gateway
sources.claim: 12th-c. water castle on 76 ha former royal estate; 8 loops, floating walkway, petting zoo.

sources.title: Terhills — Hoge Kempen National Park
sources.claim: Terhills gateway; 3.6 km green loop to Lange Terril, panorama over post-industrial heath.

sources.title: Fietsen door de Heide — Visit Limburg
sources.claim: 4 km route across 700 ha of heath, ~300 m wooden panoramic bridge over the moor.

sources.title: Fietsen door het Water — Visit Limburg
sources.claim: 200+ m dyke through a Bokrijk pond; water at eye level on both sides; opened April 2016.

sources.title: Fietsen door de Bomen — Visit Limburg
sources.claim: 700 m double-helix bridge climbing 10 m above the Pijnven pine canopy; opened June 2019.

sources.title: Fietsparadijs Limburg — pickup points
sources.claim: Bike rental hubs at Bokrijk, Station As, Kattevennen, Hasselt and others; daily 10-18, 4 Apr-8 Nov.

sources.title: Bokrijk open-air museum
sources.claim: Daily 10:00-18:00 from 4 Apr to 8 Nov; €17 adult, family ticket €37.

sources.title: C-Mine Expedition
sources.claim: 1.5 km route through old air shaft to the top of Belgium's tallest headframe (>60 m).

sources.title: Duinengordel
sources.claim: ~3,000 ha nature area in Oudsbergen with 82 km of trails; part of Hoge Kempen since 2020.

sources.title: Wijndomein Aldeneyck
sources.claim: 10 ha winery on south-east-facing Meuse slopes; multiple Best Belgian Wine awards.

sources.title: Elaisa Energetic Wellness
sources.claim: 11 saunas and 8 baths at Terhills; daily 10:00-22:00; weekday €65 / weekend €69.

sources.title: Maasmechelen Village
sources.claim: Bicester Collection's only Belgian outlet; >100 boutiques, daily 10-19 including Sunday.

sources.title: Plopsa Indoor Hasselt
sources.claim: Indoor theme park; from €15 for 85-99 cm, ≥1 m from €24 dated.

sources.title: Cosmodrome — Kattevennen
sources.claim: Planetarium at the Kattevennen gateway; €12 adult / €10 child.

sources.title: Brouwerij Cornelissen
sources.claim: Brewery in Opitter (Bree); King Mule IPA, Limburgse Witte, Bokkereyer, Herkenrode, Gummarus.

sources.title: Schatkamer Sint-Catharinakerk
sources.claim: Codex Eyckensis — oldest illuminated manuscript in Belgium; Tue-Sun 13:00-16:30.

sources.title: Domein Kelchterhoef
sources.claim: Free domain; supervised swim 1 Jul-31 Aug only; daily 10:00-18:00.

sources.title: BSides Limburg 2026
sources.claim: Community cybersecurity con at Corda Campus / PXL-NeXT, Hasselt; 12-13 March.

sources.title: IEEE WCCI 2026
sources.claim: ~1500-attendee AI/computational-intelligence congress at MECC Maastricht; 21-26 June.

sources.title: BNAIC/BeNeLearn 2026
sources.claim: 38th Benelux AI conference at Maastricht University; 21-23 October.

sources.title: FTI Festival 2026
sources.claim: Flanders Technology & Innovation festival; Hasselt and Genk as Limburg hub; 16 Oct-15 Nov.

sources.title: Thor Park events
sources.claim: Powering the Future series — pragmatic half-day workshops with networking at Genk.

sources.title: Brightlands Smart Services Campus events
sources.claim: AI / data / startup programme at Heerlen, NL — ~30 km from Slagmolen (borderline).

sources.title: Corda Campus
sources.claim: Tech campus in Hasselt hosting BSides Limburg and the FTI Festival Hasselt pillar.

sources.title: Slagmolen (Opglabbeek) — Wikipedia
sources.claim: 1511-mentioned undershot oil watermill; restored 1685; protected since 1995.
